_about: Creepypasta and analog horror: found media, wrong details, an archive that keeps going. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

medium: a public-access channel that only broadcasts at night
a website frozen years ago that still updates
a children's show nobody else remembers
anomaly: a figure that moves only between frames
a host who looks at the viewer
a place that appears on every map but this one
wrong_detail: the shadows fall the wrong way
everyone has one tooth too many
the date is in the future
the background is the viewer's own room
the audio is half a second early
source: a forum thread that was deleted
a job clearing out an old station
a parcel with no return address
spread: watching it makes you want to share it
it copies itself onto whatever it is near
others who saw it begin to call
it changes to match whoever watches
it is in the news, but only for the characters

1: a recording is a little wrong
a detail matches the character's own life
2: the wrongness follows them off the screen
someone who watched it is missing
3: the recording addresses them by name
the world around them starts to match the footage
4: they find the end of the archive, and the next entry is them

cliches: the cursed videotape kills in seven days
it was a hoax all along
